pr_readback.title: Build Rev1.18 candidate source and harden Android, trading, accounts and recovery
pr_readback.body:
This draft continues the complete Rev1.18 candidate rebuild from existing source and the frozen plan. Formal unit, full-backend and production/device acceptance remain open.

Current published source: `3732798104c476680cac8e22f833f2ed764d77e2`.

### Latest behavior

Both native MT5 entry paths now calculate the proposed order's isolated native margin and compare it with cash-backed capacity before native handoff. Credit cannot fund entry risk. Available amounts round down and commitments round up at the original account precision. Python uses exact Fraction over native text; the EA uses original 17-digit text and integer-string arithmetic.

Scope and cash are checked around calculation and at the final guard. Original identity, permission, nonce and deadline controls remain; a native read cannot renew authority. Known insufficient and unavailable facts have distinct native reply/rejection codes. Explicit zero native requirements work with positive cash, and market/limit/native-side behavior and protective tighten/close remain supported.

The signed SDK fixture and exact original EA entry body both previously reached simulated native entry in two insufficient-cash cases. The new checks stop those sends. SDK fixtures and the C++ terminal API model are explicit source evidence, without connected broker or MetaTrader runtime acceptance.

### Verification

- **5,215 passed, zero failures/errors/skips**, across full trading and selected original gateway SQL/HTTP/private-core/schema/scope checks. Actual SQLite/PostgreSQL executed; zero Python storage-audit violations. Every call ran once; all **1,258 pinned inputs** independently match committed Git objects, including SDK, EA, README and the actual C++ fixture. Owned PostgreSQL independently confirmed removed.
- Exact EA entry/helper bodies execute through the existing controlled C++ terminal model and an independent Fraction arithmetic oracle. Original test functions are preserved: 40 retain identical AST; two reviewed fixture updates preserve concurrency assertions and target the actual final native read boundary. Initial failed runs remain failed in retained evidence.
- Genuine hook, required-baseline committed verification (**GREEN191**, actual exit0), normal push and independent exact remote readback: succeeded.
- Canonical manifest: **10,301 files, zero mismatches**. Owner/frontend inventories and all frozen scope identities remain intact. Mutation registry consistency retains 374 identities/383 edits; it is not local mutation execution.
- Fresh [official MetaEditor job40692934889](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/actions/runs/40692934889) succeeded. Original artifact12817329530 independently verified: GitHub size/digest, ZIP integrity, exact changed EA source/blob, valid MetaQuotes signatures, log/binary hashes and fresh binary. Native output: **zero errors/warnings**; invalid probe: four errors/no binary. Actual process codes remain positive1/rejection0. Source SHA256 `40d15b43f2cba20a5c8dadec6db245cecc105c17a70e216ac98adb39e166bb1f`. This is SOURCE_COMPILED, without connected-account/financial/device qualification. [Exact-head main40692934675](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/actions/runs/40692934675) is still running.
- Parent catalog main40683291239 finished **FAILURE**: all 17 public jobs successful; two mandatory prerequisites failed (trusted-main checker absent, DDS read key unprovisioned). Its four supporting workflows succeeded. Independently verified parent artifact: 4,950 trading passes/one declared private-DDS skip, 26 PostgreSQL passes and 117 voice passes. These remain parent evidence.

### Full scope and continuation

[Execution method](docs/rebuild/rev118/BUILD_EXECUTION_PLAN.md) and [full workmap](docs/rebuild/rev118/SOURCE_WORKMAP.json) retain all 131 units, 324 requirements, 1,610 acceptance identities, 234 contexts, 349 actions and 93 features. Original frontend coverage remains 42 groups/105 functions/78 surfaces. [Cash-margin source receipt](docs/rebuild/rev118/receipts/MT5_FINAL_CASH_MARGIN_SOURCE_20261028.json) retains exact checks and failed attempts.

Complete shared all-origin transactional cash/margin/stop-risk reservations, post-entry margin floors, fee/fill-price contingencies, qualified FX/contract migration, active-policy arbitration, working-order/partial-fill reconciliation and native economic finality. The final native check does not complete those requirements. All payment/manual/handover, discovery/feeds/depth/entitlements, forecasts/learning/crypto, assistant, security/operations and Android functions remain required. Profitability is evaluated with evidence, never guaranteed.

Android uses its provisioned production profile on Van trading core without owner-entered backend addresses. Frontend redesign remains behind BG-001. Independent admission, signing, deployment and actual Artemis/Samsung S24 Ultra acceptance remain open. Frozen package bytes, original authority records and ledger integrity are preserved.
